authority: PLAN.md section 3.2 and explicit implementation authorization
review_rule: Independent assertions and event-level comparison to the frozen C oracle are required; candidate golden classifications never exempt a complete file.

changes.old: C sort fast path does not compare the first pair.
changes.contract: Stable ascending source_time_ms before ASS quantization.
changes.review_status: accepted: direct stable-millisecond assertions, fixed-seed properties, independent C output on stably permuted XML and external differential tests passed; see PLAN section 9

changes.old: C bucket insertion reverses equal keys when sorting is triggered.
changes.contract: Equal millisecond keys preserve input order; different keys that quantize to the same ASS time remain sorted by source milliseconds.
changes.review_status: accepted: equal-key order and pre-quantization 1001/1001/1004ms assertions, independent C permutation baseline and external differential tests passed; see PLAN section 9

changes.old: Input and escaped ASS text are truncated to 1023 bytes.
changes.contract: All valid text is retained within source and decoded byte budgets; width uses complete logical text.
changes.minimal_input_recipe: A normal d element with text = [ASCII, Chinese, emoji, combining sequence] repeated beyond 1023 input and escaped bytes.
changes.independent_assertion: Exact logical-text bytes and full-length width; no replacement or missing tail; verify later affected layout events separately.
changes.review_status: accepted: full text and independent affected-event metadata, 64MiB body and 128MiB XML stream tests, wide coordinate/font bounds and distinct performance workload passed; see PLAN section 9

changes.old: Byte truncation can split UTF-8; consumer silently drops invalid bytes.
changes.contract: Valid UTF-8 remains complete; invalid source UTF-8 and invalid XML numeric character references produce input errors.
changes.minimal_input_recipe: Use multibyte characters crossing byte 1023; test raw byte FF and XML � independently.
changes.independent_assertion: std::str::from_utf8 succeeds on output; exact byte suffix retained; invalid input rejected before publication.
changes.review_status: accepted: exact valid Unicode suffix bytes and complete ASS UTF-8 verified; malformed UTF-8 and numeric references rejected, literal escaped references preserved; see PLAN section 9

changes.old: readXml and assEscape both decode XML entities and numeric references.
changes.contract: Decode XML once, then escape ordinary ASS text independently. Preserve type7 raw ASS and legacy /n semantics.
changes.independent_assertion: Logical text contains literal < and �, braces cannot become override blocks, literal backslash escapes cannot become line breaks or spaces.
changes.review_status: accepted: once-only entity/CDATA parsing, independent affected and unchanged event assertions and Legacy byte comparisons passed; type7 raw ASS retained; see PLAN section 9

changes.contract: Rust parsing and serialization always use dot decimals and produce identical output in C and installed comma-decimal locales.
changes.independent_assertion: Independent locale child processes both succeed with identical output; keep ErrorKind::Locale JSON compatibility.
changes.review_status: accepted on Linux: independent host subprocesses actually set C/comma LC_NUMERIC and compare complete public API ASS bytes; other OS runtime validation remains Gate5; see PLAN section 9
